text: Aoife - 1st gig w/ new band @ the Brudenell 14 May. v nervous, keeps saying she'll forget the words. text her good luck that morning
Lior: veggie, no mushrooms ever. only drinks oat flat whites lol

Xavier & Eva both doing the Manchester half 3rd of April - Eva's first, Xavier's done loads. she's def nervous, he's being v smug abt it. carb-load dinner @ ours the night before, I'm doing the pasta (Xavier no dairy, Eva no nuts). they want a lift to the start that morning too. text Eva good luck the day before + ask how she found it afterwards
Karim's cup final called off - pitch waterlogged. rescheduled sometime after Christmas apparently, no date yet
Joy - coeliac + sesame allergy. her bday sometime in the spring, she mentioned wanting a proper afternoon tea. need to find a gf place that does one
oat milk, gf bread, bin bags. dentist 22/10 @ 9
Akira's piano recital went really well apparently!! his teacher cried. ask him abt the Chopin piece next time
Archie Lewis (Arch) - chess tournament in Leeds 9th Nov. his dad driving him up the day before. remind me to ask Arch how he got on afterwards
Ivan off booze for Oct - sober october thing. sparkling water w/ lime when we go out, he's fine w/ pubs
Bogdan & Dorota - 10 yr anniversary 2 June. she's dropping hints re a new espresso machine, he's clueless

call w/ Isaac. his mum's back in hosp - same chest thing as last yr, they're keeping her in for tests. he's struggling a bit, not sleeping. flying home to Lagos soon, prob next wk once work signs it off. his wife Joanna staying here w/ the kids. check in w/ him the day after he lands, and maybe drop round to Joanna's w/ food sometime that wk - kids only eat plain pasta lol
Chen - lactose intolerant, loves spicy food. hates coriander (soap thing)
Andile's choir concert 30/11 @ St Mary's. me + Keisha going, I'm getting tix. drinks afterwards somewhere nearby
Santiago ran the Cardiff 10k sunday, PB!! 41 mins. knee a bit sore since
Zainab - nut allergy (serious, carries epipen). also doesn't drink. remember for the work xmas do

Stefan's play opening night 18 Oct @ the Playhouse - lead role!! he was super stressed at dress rehearsal, forgot half of act 2. his partner Kenji says he's barely eating. we're going the 2nd night instead (19th), Magda got the tix. msg Stefan the next day to see how it went + flowers for the stage door on the 19th
Kenji into craft beer, esp sours. mentioned a tasting thing in Bristol sometime in the new year
Jess - darts final at the Crown fri. her bf Eli is doing the scoring lol. she's fine abt it, v chill
Dimitri's daughter has her grade 5 violin exam 12th March. he's more nervous than she is
Dorota keto again. no bread at lunch. Magda also cutting sugar, both v strict atm
Ben - 5 a side tonight cancelled, not enough ppl. moved to next Weds maybe

Joanna doing a triathlon in the summer, first one ever - Windermere, July sometime, date tbc. training 6am every day, swim club Tues/Thurs. bit terrified of the open water swim tbh, she had a panic thing in the lake last yr. also cut out caffeine bc of it, now on matcha?? I should send her that wetsuit link + ask if she wants company on a practice swim
Aditi's wedding catering sorted - all veg, Jain options for her grandparents (no onion/garlic). wedding 7 Sept
must book MOT b4 end of month. also renew passport sometime soon
Fatima's brother Karim got into the regional squad! trials were last wk. she's buzzing. send congrats to both
Duc Nguyen - pescatarian, loves pho obvs, wants to try that Vietnamese place in town. his mum visiting from Hanoi in Dec

Arjun's band gig 5/12 @ the Deaf Institute, their last one before they split - drummer moving to Berlin. Arjun weirdly sad abt it, says it's the end of an era. Eamon + me going, maybe Joy if she's not on shift. pre drinks @ Eamon's that eve. remind me to ask Arjun abt merch the week before, want a shirt
Eli doesn't eat pork, no shellfish either. prefers red wine over white. bbq sat
Keisha - spoken word night @ the library sometime next month. hasn't picked a date. she's nervous abt reading her own stuff
Eamon's dog Rolo had his op today - knee. Eamon v shaken. ring him tmrw eve
Saw Magda @ the market. she's doing a bake-off comp at work 14/11, entering her lemon drizzle. her husband Stefan banned from tasting lol
Xavier - allergic to cats + strawberries. Eva his sister is the opposite, eats strawberries every day
football match w/ Bogdan 24 Feb, Wembley. leave by 10 that morning. I've got the tix
Akira Tanaka's sumo thing - he's competing in the amateur nationals sometime in the spring. trains 4x a wk, eats loads of rice. ask how training's going
Ivan and his partner Joy expecting! due late May. Joy can't do soft cheese or wine now, keep in mind for dinner 1st of Feb
Chen's half marathon got called off (heat warning). gutted. doing a different one in Oct instead, Chester 19/10

Isaac + his wife Aoife hosting quiz night @ theirs sometime after Christmas, maybe Jan. Aoife v stressed abt the food - half the guests veggie, one coeliac (Joy), and Isaac's brother won't eat anything 'foreign' lol. she's doing a big chilli + jacket potatoes. offer to bring a gf dessert, prob the brownies
karaoke comp @ the Swan - Andile won!! sang Whitney. prize is a bar tab haha
Santiago - teetotal, loves Coke Zero. vegan since summer. birthday 3rd of Aug, wants vinyl - anything Bad Bunny

Long chat w/ Zainab. her little brother Ben has his first county cricket match 2 June, she's taking him. he's v anxious, barely slept last wk. their dad can't go bc of work. she wants us to make a banner?? I said yes. need to buy card + paint the weekend before. also she's off dairy now, migraines

Kenji - did the Great North Swim last sat. got cramp halfway, had to stop and get pulled out by the safety kayak. bit embarrassed, didn't want to talk abt it much. his sister Keisha said he'd been training for months. wants to try again next yr. ask him abt it gently, maybe next wk over coffee - he only drinks decaf now
Jess said Dimitri's moving to Glasgow sometime in the new year. leaving do prob mid Jan
Lior's daughter Aditi in the school play 11/12, she's the narrator. Lior filming it. ask to see the video afterwards
Dorota hates tea. coffee only, black, strong

Fatima's 40th - 15 March. dinner @ the Lebanese place on Oxford Rd, she loves halloumi + anything w/ pomegranate. no alcohol, mocktails for her. her husband Santiago organising, surprise for the guests not her. card + flowers the day before, don't forget. maybe a cookbook as a gift - she mentioned the Ottolenghi one
Archie's poetry slam got postponed indefinitely. venue flooded
Joanna Barros - allergic to penicillin, carries a card. mentions it every time we hike
cinema w/ Eli thurs. bring snacks, he doesn't like popcorn
Arjun Yilmaz's school reunion sometime in the summer, he's organising. mentioned Eamon might not come
Duc's mum making bánh xèo for everyone fri, she's a v good cook. Duc says no shrimp in mine
Keisha + her bro Kenji both running Sunday's 5k for charity 20/9. sponsor them both b4 the weekend
Magda back from Kraków. brought pierogi for the office. her nan isn't well, tests 3rd of Nov
Stefan - wine snob, loves a Barolo. dropping hints abt a decanter for Xmas
Xavier said the darts league got cancelled for the season. he's now doing padel instead, Weds nights
Dimitri, Aoife and me tried that new ramen place. Dimitri's gluten free now, had to get rice noodles. Aoife spice wimp

Eva - the swim meet was today, regionals. came 2nd in 100m back! 0.3s off 1st. her coach says nationals maybe in the spring if she keeps it up. she's starving after every session, eats like 4 bananas. her mum was in tears. text her congrats tonight and ask when nationals is
gym 7am, then laundry. meal prep sun
Ben's mum's birthday 8/7. he wants to take her to a jazz brunch. find out if Ronnie's does Sunday sets
Joy + Ivan - baby shower 12 April. Joy prefers mocktails, Ivan doing the playlist. I'm bringing the cake
Karim's daughter starts ballet comps in the spring. he's nervous for her, she's 6. their cat Pickle also unwell, vet the next day
